headline: Adient Boosts Buyback Program by $400M and Adopts Tax Plan
summary: Adient increased its share repurchase program by $400 million and adopted a new tax plan.
why: Share buyback expansions signal management confidence in capital return and balance sheet strength, often supporting equity valuations.

impacts.name: Adient
impacts.why: Expanding the share buyback program by $400 million directly impacts capital allocation and equity supply.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expanding a buyback program reduces share float and indicates corporate confidence, supporting market pricing.
